title: Your data
summary: Export, backup and where the data lives.

requirements.text: Export writes a consistent snapshot of the whole database, photos included, and hands it to the Android share sheet (on desktop, shows the file's path).
A new photo is stored in the database, named by the SHA-256 of its bytes.

history.text: Photos are stored in the database, named by the SHA-256 of their bytes.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: older photos keep their earlier names.

requirements.text: On Android, when the last complete sync with another device of the vault is older than `backup.stale-after`, the Diary shows a reminder to open Tally on that device.

history.text: When the last backup is older than `backup.stale-after`, the app reminds the user to make one.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: the backup is a sync to another device, not an export, and the reminder is Android-only.

requirements.text: Exports, the computer's daily copies and the copy replaced when joining a vault are marked as copies.

history.text: Copies the app makes of the database (exports, snapshots, the pre-migration backup) are marked as copies.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: the pre-migration backup is not marked.

requirements.text: Schema changes are applied as versioned migrations when the app starts.
